fuel_type.note: Generators only: diesel, gasoline, propane. Leave out (or none) for everything that burns no fuel: solar, wind turbines, batteries, wiring.

fuel_consumption_l_per_min.note: liters per IN-GAME minute of running (40 real minutes = 1 full in-game day = 1440 in-game minutes at 1x speed) Generators only: leave out for anything that burns no fuel (a wind turbine, a solar panel).

max_power_w.note: max power throughput/output in watts, for sources and regulators only (generators, inverters, charge controllers, solar panels, breaker panels/switches). 0 for storage (batteries - see Wh naming instead), passive hardware (wire, poles, conduit), and anything that doesn't source or pass through power.

max_current_a.note: rated current in amps, for protection and switching parts that are bought by their amp rating (circuit breakers, fuses, disconnects). The name generators show it: 'DC Circuit Breaker (32 A)'. Leave it out (or 0) for everything else; a stored name never carries the rating.

tank_capacity_l.note: liters the item's own onboard fuel tank holds (generators only - a portable/standby generator carries its own small tank, same concept as vehicles.tank_capacity_l). 0 for everything else. Generators only: leave out for anything that burns no fuel (a wind turbine, a solar panel).
